captionedVideo.verificationScope: export-manifest receipt; not rehashed or decoded by this reviewer

reviewMethod.nativeMeaning: The native contact boards contain scaled tiles derived from actual 1920x1080 captioned-master frames. These are not 107 separate full-resolution image inspections.

additionalFullNativeFramesDirectlyOpened.reason: Read original membership title, profile/name rows, coaching URL and logo at 1920x1080.

observations.observed: The assembled vehicle visibly translates relative to terrain and nearby fixed structures. The hollow green vehicle callout follows its changing position and apparent size. Inventory/editing returns at frame 18157, a held green component with connection nodes is visible at frame 18371, and solid rear structure/guns remain at frame 18607. The held preview is not falsely labelled as a completed installation.
observations.annotationChecks: Vehicle mark begins at frame 17798 (source local 163.0), follows sampled 0.5-second keys and intermediate points through frame 18007 (166.4833), and is absent at frame 18008 (166.5). No stale vehicle mark remains after this interval or into the next cut.
observations.captionAndMobileChecks: Cue 53/54 boxes stay below the vehicle and editing target. The vehicle outline and short label remain distinguishable in actual 375-pixel samples. Fine game HUD and source-credit lettering are naturally small at this scale.
observations.claimLimits: These frames support change/test/change workflow, not a measured speed or damage improvement. Projectile effects do not establish a numerical weapon-performance claim.

observations.observed: Actual TerraTech is followed by a black/yellow explanation with the change/test/change loop. Its bridge distinguishes improved performance from an appearance the player likes. The next source is Animal Crossing: New Horizons; its caption begins after the source cut. No TerraTech callout carries into the Animal Crossing screen.
observations.claimLimits: The visible question, captions and objects provide semantic continuity. This is not a claim that the audio join was listened to.

observations.observed: Character creation shows style, skin, hairstyle, eyes and other appearance choices. Distinct actual hairstyles are visible before/after selection: jagged red hair, a short/side-cut appearance and a longer parted appearance. The green hollow head outline encloses the hair without covering the face. The preview arrow traces from the selected option toward the avatar.
observations.annotationChecks: Head mark appears at frame 19755 (source local 149.5). Preview arrow starts at frame 19815 (150.5), reveals progressively at frames 19824/19833, and is fully visible at frame 19875. It clears at frame 19935 (152.5); the remaining head mark clears at frame 19995 (153.5). No stale annotation survives the cut.
observations.captionAndMobileChecks: Cue 59 and surrounding fixed captions avoid the hairstyle selector, avatar head and short annotation labels. The appearance change and arrow direction remain identifiable at 375-pixel width. The actual game interface and source credit are retained.
observations.claimLimits: The footage demonstrates appearance preview and selection. It does not demonstrate increased strength or changed combat performance.

observations.observed: The ACNH example returns to the performance/appearance distinction, then the conclusion combines actual Jets2, ACVI and TerraTech evidence around choosing, finding and testing. Jets2 SHOP and cosmetic PROFILE views are used with distinct roles. The final question about equipment/customization screens remains over actual PROFILE appearance controls until the membership cut.
observations.captionAndStyleChecks: No clipped caption, missing visible glyph, stale callout or explanatory-label occlusion was found in these samples. Explanation scenes retain black ground, white text, warm yellow focus and the existing caption position. The last question is visible at frames 24079, 24177 and 24319.
observations.claimLimits: The cosmetic PROFILE view intentionally supports appearance choice; it is not described as a weapon-stat comparison. Semantic continuity is sampled visually, not verified by continuous audio listening.

observations.observed: The final captioned question ends before the membership screen. The original white membership layout is visible at its first/next and final sampled frames, with twelve profile/name/badge rows, original title, coaching link and bottom-right Yamyam Coding logo. No fixed narration caption covers the membership card.
observations.fullResolutionRead: Existing frame 24320 was opened at 1920x1080 to read the original title, profile rows, coaching URL and logo. Uncertain/truncated handles are not re-transcribed or renamed by this report.

durationEvidence.basis: Recorded frame plan and final video header, with direct first/next/last sampled pixels; not continuous review of all 600 membership frames.

observations.receiptLimit: Source branding/membership clips were byte-preserved before concat according to cuts-build.json. This report does not claim the final re-encoded master preserves identical packet bytes.

nonBlockingLimits: Fine game HUD and long source-credit text are small in a 375-pixel whole-video preview; the main target, state changes, arrow direction and fixed captions are distinguishable in the reviewed samples.
This report covers only boards 26-37 and 107 unique frame samples, not earlier boards, all 71 caption cues, every moving frame or full continuous playback.
English text in the manifest is a reference field, not burned English caption pixels. This report is not a fresh complete KO/EN text audit.
Final human listening/pronunciation and full continuous playback remain outside this reviewer assignment. No successful sampled visual check is promoted to whole-video or human approval.
